fields.description: What the item points at. Left empty on an overlay row, which carries a flag for a shared row rather than content of its own.
fields.label: Type

fields.description: Overrides the linked view's label, so a shared view can read shorter on one user's sidebar without being renamed for everyone. Required for a type with no view to borrow from.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The doctype a doctype item opens the list of. The route it leads to is resolved on read rather than stored.
fields.label: DocType

fields.description: Where a link item points: an absolute URL, a path in this app, or a hash such as #settings/general.
fields.label: URL

fields.description: Derived from the URL when the item is created — another origin opens in a new tab, a path or a hash in place — and stored from then on, so a later edit stands.
fields.label: New Tab

fields.description: On a personal overlay, the shared section row this one carries the user's order and hidden flag for. Empty on any section that is not an overlay.
fields.label: Overrides
